status: predeclared; no model evaluation has occurred
independence: Defined from goal.md H1-H10 and J before reading implementation or observing tested model output.

failed_approach.history_required: A real writer reproduces the seeded LIKE lookup failure for IDs containing SQL wildcard characters, repairs the lookup, and runs a validation command.
failed_approach.consumer_outcome: cart.total returns exact-ID Decimal totals for wildcard and ordinary SKUs; absent IDs raise KeyError; SQL injection does not select another item.
failed_approach.benefit_measure: Compare repeated lookup investigation and tool/model usage while maintaining all functional checks. A correct final result alone does not prove history helped.

build_prerequisite.history_required: A real writer encounters the missing generated schema in a fresh checkout, discovers and executes tools/build.py, then repairs the decoder.
build_prerequisite.consumer_outcome: Fresh consumer builds its own schema and encoder emits schema-ordered typed JSON; generated artifact must exist before checker runs and writer-repaired decoder must complete a typed round-trip.
build_prerequisite.benefit_measure: Count failed imports, repeated build discovery, successful generation and elapsed tool time.

branch_constraint.history_required: A real writer works on partner-unicode; the default branch requires ASCII while partner-unicode preserves Unicode.
branch_constraint.consumer_outcome: routes.path_for honors the current branch's explicit slug policy, including Unicode, repeated separators, and case folding.
branch_constraint.benefit_measure: Measure correct branch-specific behavior and inappropriate guidance on the main variant.

unfinished_checkpoint.history_required: Interrupt a real writer only after a meaningful incomplete code edit; retain that exact snapshot and actual run evidence. If writer finished, this fixture is invalid as an unfinished handoff.
unfinished_checkpoint.consumer_outcome: reconcile.run reads both CSV inputs, validates duplicate IDs and malformed quantities, returns sorted stock deltas and CLI prints the same JSON.
unfinished_checkpoint.benefit_measure: Compare resumed investigation, duplicate work and completeness; inspect actual checkpoint separately from durable findings.

stale_guidance.history_required: Writer observes half-up rounding; advance makes a new source commit requiring half-even rounding after writer work is frozen.
stale_guidance.consumer_outcome: invoice.total rounds each line under current policy before summing and returns two-decimal strings. Half-even ties distinguish stale half-up advice.
stale_guidance.benefit_measure: Count uses of obsolete rounding and verify historical evidence remains inspectable but qualified.

conflicting_interpretations.history_required: Two independent real writer sessions inspect contradictory customer and finance guides; any resulting findings retain both source identities. Contradiction must not be resolved by timestamp.
conflicting_interpretations.consumer_outcome: quotes.quote follows runtime tax_mode for both inclusive and exclusive settings. DECISION.md names both conflicting guides and the runtime authority.
conflicting_interpretations.benefit_measure: Inspect whether both interpretations were considered and source authority resolved the conflict; the checker measures behavior and referenced documents, not quality of reasoning.

integration_applicability.history_required: Real writer on transport-v2 discovers packet digest depends on exact serialized bytes. Consumer main excludes that guidance before merge; verified no-ff merge makes v2 applicable afterward.
integration_applicability.consumer_outcome: packets.packet returns current transport wire bytes as hex and matching SHA256; main-before is v1 and main-after is v2, with a real merge in Git history.
integration_applicability.benefit_measure: Compare before/after context, final packet behavior, and actual inheritance explanation. Final artifacts alone cannot establish a database path.

no_history.history_required: None. Skip writer and provide empty historical context to all conditions.
no_history.consumer_outcome: stats.histogram counts signed integers with integer keys without modifying input, including empty input.
no_history.benefit_measure: Compare correctness and overhead without historical guidance; any irrelevant capture or recall requires disclosure.
